headline: Gold prices jump: 22K gold rises by 9,856 taka per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced the new prices effective from Thursday, citing a rise in the cost of pure gold.
details: Gold and silver prices have increased in the domestic market as of Thursday. The price of 22-carat gold has risen by 9,856 taka per bhori, with the new rates effective from 10:00 AM.
The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) issued a press release stating that the price hike was driven by the increase in the cost of pure gold in the local market.
Under the new rates, 22-carat gold is now priced at 232,930 taka per bhori. Other categories include 21-carat at 222,491 taka, 18-carat at 191,056 taka, and traditional gold at 156,640 taka.
Before this hike, 22-carat gold was priced at 223,074 taka per bhori. The price of silver has also increased, with 22-carat silver now costing 4,898 taka per bhori and 21-carat silver at 4,666 taka.
Historically, gold prices reached their peak on January 29 of this year, when a single-day jump of 16,213 taka pushed the price to 286,000 taka per bhori.
For the 2026-27 fiscal year, the government has set a VAT of 2,500 taka per bhori on gold jewelry, which is included in the price, meaning jewelry stores will not collect separate VAT from customers.
caption:
Gold prices in Bangladesh just took a massive leap. 22K gold is now nearly 10,000 taka more expensive per bhori.

Gold and silver prices have increased in the domestic market as of Thursday. The price of 22-carat gold has risen by 9,856 taka per bhori, with the new rates effective from 10:00 AM.

The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) issued a press release stating that the price hike was driven by the increase in the cost of pure gold in the local market.

Under the new rates, 22-carat gold is now priced at 232,930 taka per bhori. Other categories include 21-carat at 222,491 taka, 18-carat at 191,056 taka, and traditional gold at 156,640 taka.

Before this hike, 22-carat gold was priced at 223,074 taka per bhori. The price of silver has also increased, with 22-carat silver now costing 4,898 taka per bhori and 21-carat silver at 4,666 taka.

Historically, gold prices reached their peak on January 29 of this year, when a single-day jump of 16,213 taka pushed the price to 286,000 taka per bhori.

For the 2026-27 fiscal year, the government has set a VAT of 2,500 taka per bhori on gold jewelry, which is included in the price, meaning jewelry stores will not collect separate VAT from customers.

headline: Dismembered body parts of woman found in Dhaka's Sabujbag
summary: Police recovered the severed head and two hands of an unidentified woman, estimated to be around 20 years old, from a shopping bag in Madartek Baganbari.
details: Police recovered the severed head and two hands of an unidentified woman from Dhaka’s Sabujbagh area this morning. The body parts were found around 8:00 am beneath a culvert beside a canal at Madartek Baganbari.
Acting on information, officers found the remains in a shopping bag left on a pile of garbage beneath the culvert, according to Sub-Inspector Nure Alam Siddique of Sabujbagh Police Station.
The remaining parts of the body have not yet been found, and police are searching the surrounding areas for further clues.

The victim's identity could not be established immediately, but police estimate she was about 20 years old. The Criminal Investigation Department's forensic team has been informed to assist in identification.
The recovered body parts are being sent to the morgue at Dhaka Medical College for an autopsy to determine the cause of death.
Investigators are also collecting CCTV footage from nearby areas to identify those involved in the crime.
Police suspect the woman was killed elsewhere before her body was beheaded and dismembered to conceal the crime.
